intuition.title: Why a ZnS shell and a silica overlayer?
intuition.summary: The ZnS shell is used to improve core photoluminescence through surface passivation; silica makes the originally hydrophobic stock dispersible in aqueous media and supplies coupling chemistry. The source frames silica as robust and biocompatible but does not conduct a toxicity or cellular-safety assay. Optical retention, size, charge and reactive groups are tested here.
intuition.scope: Source discussion; interpretation and cited context are distinguished in the text.

general_background.title: Thermodynamics and kinetics
general_background.summary: Thermodynamics describes which states are energetically favoured, while kinetics governs how quickly a system can move between them. A change can be favourable yet proceed slowly when an activation barrier or limited transport restricts the pathway.
